'''2006 Yavin IV Regional Reid Smith LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2006 Yavin IV Regional]], finishing 1st; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by R. "Voice of Law" Smith (2006-04-03).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35485 V Is For Vindicator]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20070923124121/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35485 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Original post ==

'''V Is For Vindicator'''
* '''Author:''' R. "Voice of Law" Smith
* '''Published:''' April 3, 2006
* '''Rating:''' 4.8
* '''Description:''' WYSv that went 4-0 to take frist place at Yavin IV Regionals 2oo6.

=== Strategy ===

Set up with random Corellians at your random sites, drain for 2 at each one. If the opponent battles you there, Barrier/Houjix/use objective to get rid of battle damage. It doesn't matter if they take your sites as long as you stay flipped by occupying two battlegrounds in space.

Drain for a bunch in space, and if the opponent battles you, play DDTA shield to pull Legendary and win a battle with NQA + All Wings combo + maybe A Few Maneuvers. Cause direct damage with Legendary and/or Padme and/or Uncontrollable Fury. Remember Padme works in space too which is pretty retarded. You can easily find Padme or UFury with your FOUR Tunnel Visions.

The Falcon seems random at frist but it is a great card. BoShek is matching for it and he + Falcon deploy for 3. Plus teh Falcon can react at Corellia and loves to hold Legendary for 2 force loss a turn. Pull it with All Wings combo.

A lot of times I don't even end up putting teh right pilots on teh right ships. NQA gives everyone immunity so it doesn't really matter.

Against cloaking Maul u have X-Wing Cannon and SATM combo.

Yes this deck can have some trouble against Forced Landing and/or Sim Aloo but I've tested it and I'll take my chances. And it completely and utterly demolishes anything else. If you are really worried about Sim Aloo you can add in Rycar and Demotion. Rycar pulls Fury also so it's not a total waste.

For further inquiries please see my Origins 2oo5 deck, "Teh (V)indicator"

� 2oo6 rsmithworld

a ReidTech Inc. Production
